name: openGym
author: DuarteSantos8
description: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker. Plan a routine per weekday over a library of 1324 exercises with animated demos, run guided sessions with rest timers, supersets, warm-up sets and automatic progression (linear, Greyskull LP, double progression), and track your estimated 1RM, body weight and training volume over time. Each profile signs in with a passkey and syncs across devices, data is stored as plain JSON files you can back up, and there is no telemetry.

form_fields.label: Public URL
form_fields.hint: Full URL you open openGym with, without a trailing slash (e.g. https://gym.example.com or http://192.168.1.10:8084). Passkeys are bound to it, so it must match exactly.

form_fields.label: Passkey hostname
form_fields.hint: Hostname part of the public URL, with no scheme, port or path (e.g. gym.example.com). Browsers only allow passkeys over HTTPS, with localhost as the one exception.

form_fields.label: Admin user IDs
form_fields.hint: Optional, comma-separated. Enables the admin dashboard for those profiles. Register your passkey first, then take your id from data/app/db.json (users[].id).
